entities.summary: Gustave-Henri Jossot, also known as Abdul Karim Jossot (1866–1951), was a French artist, caricaturist, and writer, born in Dijon. He is known for working on L'Assiette au Beurre. In 1911, he first travelled to Tunisia, where he would settle for the rest of his life and career, publishing in local magazines.
